Built on the foundation of our successful website Bedandbreakfast.nl (est. 2000), we bring the most beautiful B&Bs, apartments, and holiday homes together on one platform. For travellers who aren't looking for a standard hotel room, but for a unique experience. 200+ Countries and regions 120,000+ Destinations for you to discover 1,500,000+ Small-scale accommodations for your next trip Hanny Arens Founder Bedandbreakfast.eu Not a single B&B is identical to another one. Wherever you are in the world, you can count on a unique stay. That diversity is precisely what makes small-scale accommodations so appealing. At the same time, every affiliated accommodation reflects a love for their profession: a passion for hospitality, interior design, historic buildings or the beautiful region in which they are located. Or how about a guesthouse in Bali or a lodge in South Africa? Our small-scale accommodations are more than just a place to sleep; they are places where you can enjoy a carefree stay in the world's most beautiful destinations and truly feel part of your surroundings. Fair for both guest and host We believe that hospitality flourishes best through a direct connection between guest and host. That is why we do not charge any commission on reservation requests made directly with our accommodations. This allows guests to reserve their stay at a fair price while hosts retain full control over their business operations. Additionally, we collaborate with partners to make our global offering as comprehensive as possible. In doing so, we keep the sector accessible and sustainable. Welcome to our world of small-scale accommodation Whether you are dreaming of a unique overnight stay across the border, want to start your own B&B adventure, or have been welcoming guests for years: everything comes together on our platform. We understand the world of small-scale accommodation like no other and share the passion for this profession. Our mission is clear: we connect travellers worldwide with extraordinary places that are easy to find and simple to reserve.
